title: ARPAPED Runtime Event
description: Two kinds of event, both written by blueprint.dep.runtime_log into the same JSONL stream (2-RULES.md glossary: runtime event). A 'capability_call' event: one real Bridge call, success or failure -- hooked into a Bridge's own handle(), written once per call, for every call it ever handles. A 'resolution' event: an EXPLICIT record of how a prior capability_call failure was fixed -- written deliberately by whoever (agent or human) actually diagnosed and fixed it, never auto-inferred from a later success (Bridge.handle can't know a later success was a deliberate fix vs. coincidence, so this stays a deliberate act, the same discipline agent-cycle-report.schema.json's decisions[].failure/correction already holds). Distinct from verification-record.schema.json: that record is written once per verified CYCLE, by a harness; these events are written per CALL and per FIX, by the Bridge and by whoever resolves a failure, harness-scripted or genuine production traffic alike.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC -- when the Bridge finished handling this call (success or failure).

input.description: Copied from BridgeRequest.input verbatim -- same authenticity discipline as verification-record.schema.json's checks[].input.

trace.description: Whatever stages were actually reached -- validated -> discovered -> policy_evaluated -> selected -> executed. Partial (even empty, for a call that failed BridgeRequest.validate() before reaching any stage) on failure -- the same OBSERVED, never-constructed trace verification-record.schema.json's checks[].trace already requires (R8, Gate 28); an empty array here is an honest report of zero stages reached, never padded to look like more happened.

implementation_id.description: Present once the 'selected' stage was reached; absent for a call that failed before selection.

selection.description: Bridge-level Decision Context (2-RULES.md glossary) -- present only on a call that reached 'selected'. Same shape as verification-record.schema.json's checks[].selection, copied from the Bridge's own observed response.selection, never invented.

evidence.description: Process-kind (executor_kind: process) execution evidence -- present only when the selected implementation ran out-of-process. Same shape as verification-record.schema.json's checks[].evidence.

error.description: Present only when outcome is 'failure' -- the Bridge's own BridgeError code/stage/message/details, copied verbatim, never reworded.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, UTC -- when this resolution was recorded, not necessarily when the fix itself was made.

resolves_event_id.description: The event_id of the capability_call event (outcome: failure) this resolves -- an explicit link, never guessed by matching capability_id/operation or timestamp proximity (2-RULES.md "No silent defaults on what resolution depends on").

summary.description: The short, greppable label for what was wrong -- same posture as agent-cycle-report.schema.json's decisions[].failure.summary.

detail.description: What was actually changed to fix it -- same posture as decisions[].correction.detail.

verified_by_event_id.description: Optional: the event_id of a LATER capability_call event (outcome: success) that proves the fix actually worked -- a real, observed re-run, never just a claim that it's fixed.

commit.description: Optional: the git commit sha (blueprint.dep.git_commit_event) that made this fix, when the fix happened to be committed. Never required -- DEP references git when relevant but never depends on it; a fix not yet committed is still a real, recordable resolution.
